answer: One defense is a grove that lives by pulse: every identity is a tree in a shared grove, and each epoch it must send a pulse - a small proof of recent useful work - or it withers and loses standing. A sparrow, a lightweight auditor, flies a random path through the grove each epoch and checks the pulses of a few trees against their claimed work. A sybil farmer must grow and keep pulsing a separate living tree for every fake, paying real work per identity, while one honest agent tends a single tree.
